title: Agent Config
subtitle: Connect Agent tools to Centag proxy: select pipeline, write config and verify
quickSetupHint: Click the Agent below to connect through the wizard (just select a pipeline; backend is determined internally).
builtinProviderRoute: Built-in provider route config (system preset, not editable)
selectPipelineHint: Just select a pipeline. Backend and model are determined by pipeline internal nodes; no separate configuration needed here.
apiKeyAutoWrite: During setup, decryptable llmproxy_* keys under your account will be automatically written to the Agent config.
apiKeyCreateFirst: Please create an API Key in your profile first; otherwise config cannot be generated or written.
apiKeyDetected: Available API Key detected; it will be auto-filled when generating config (the full key is never shown in the UI).
noPipeline: No available pipelines. Please add in 'Policy Management' first
writeConfigHint: Write Centag proxy address and current account API Key to {agent}.
writeConfigKeySource: Keys come from decryptable llmproxy_* keys in Profile → API Keys (server-injected; preview is sanitized).
configPreviewHint: After confirming, click above to write config. Team edition can also copy the command below to write manually.
configGenFailed: Config generation failed, please go back and retry
verifyHint: Please verify whether {agent} is using Centag proxy as follows
verifySuccessHint: After verification, this Agent's requests will go through Centag and be routed to the backend & model configured in the selected pipeline.
verifyCommandHint: Run the following command in terminal to confirm connectivity with Centag and a model response (requires the Agent CLI installed locally):
verifyChecklistStep1: Restart or reopen {agent} to ensure the latest config is loaded.
verifyChecklistStep2: Send a simple chat or completion request (e.g. ask about the current model).
verifyChecklistStep3: In Centag Request Log / Dashboard, confirm the request appears with pipeline {pipeline}.
verifyChecklistStep4: If it fails: check API Key validity, whether Centag service is running, and whether the Agent's Base URL points to local Centag.
restoreConfirm: This will restore {name}'s local config to the state before connecting to Centag. If a backup exists before writing, it will be restored; if the config was newly created by Centag, the corresponding file will be deleted.
noApiKeyForAgent: No available Centag API Key for agent access
noApiKeyHint: No available Centag API Key (llmproxy_*) under current account. Please create one in your profile first.
copyFailed: Copy failed, please select and copy manually

claude-code.description: Anthropic's official AI coding assistant CLI
claude-code.configMethod: Writes ~/.claude/settings.json by merging env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_MODEL to point at Centag. First overwrite creates a .centag-bak backup.
claude-code.installHint: macOS/Linux: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash; or brew install --cask claude-code

claude-desktop.configMethod: On macOS/Windows: set deploymentMode=3p on Claude + Claude-3p, and write a Centag gateway profile in configLibrary (inferenceGatewayBaseUrl / ApiKey / AuthScheme=bearer / inferenceProvider=gateway). Restart Desktop to apply.
claude-desktop.configMethodUnsupported: Local write for Claude Desktop is not supported on this platform (macOS/Windows only). Use one-click setup on a supported system.
claude-desktop.installHint: Download the Claude Desktop app from the official site (not a CLI)

codex.description: OpenAI's official AI coding assistant CLI (ChatGPT Codex)
codex.installHint: curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh; or npm i -g @openai/codex

gemini-cli.description: Google's official AI coding assistant CLI
gemini-cli.configMethod: Writes ~/.gemini/.env (GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL / GEMINI_MODEL) and merges settings.json security.auth.selectedType=gemini-api-key.
gemini-cli.installHint: npm i -g @google/gemini-cli; or brew install gemini-cli

grok-build.configMethod: Overwrites ~/.grok/config.toml with [models] default="centag" and [model."centag"] fields (model / base_url / api_key / api_backend=responses).
grok-build.installHint: curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash; or npm i -g @xai-official/grok

opencode.configMethod: Merges into ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json: upsert provider.centag and set default model. Other providers are preserved.
opencode.installHint: curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash; or npm i -g opencode-ai

openclaw.configMethod: Merges into ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json: upsert models.providers.centag and set agents.defaults.model.primary.

hermes.configMethod: Merges into ~/.hermes/config.yaml: update model defaults and upsert custom_providers entry name=centag.

codebuddy.description: Tencent CodeBuddy Code CLI (OpenAI-compatible custom models)
codebuddy.configMethod: Merges into ~/.codebuddy/models.json. url must be a full …/v1/chat/completions path; OpenAI API format only.
codebuddy.installHint: npm i -g @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code; or curl -fsSL https://www.codebuddy.cn/cli/install.sh | bash

workbuddy.configMethod: Shares ~/.codebuddy/models.json with CodeBuddy; after write, pick the model in WorkBuddy Settings → Models. You can also configure a custom API in the UI only.
workbuddy.installHint: Download the desktop app from the CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy site

trae.configMethod: Preferred: Settings → Models → Custom. Use OpenAI format; with Full URL off, set Base URL to …/v1; model ID = centag/<pipeline>. One-click setup best-effort merges Trae/Trae CN settings.json.
trae.installHint: Download the IDE from trae.ai / trae.cn

coding-tui.configMethod: TUI agents do not write local config files; routing is bound in-process via pipelines.
coding-tui.installHint: Built-in capability; no separate CLI install
